facts.fact: MainOne, an Equinix Company, announced the launch in November 2023 of its expanded open-access, carrier-neutral AB1.2 data centre at VITIB, Grand Bassam, which it describes as built to 'Uptime Tier III standards' and which sells colocation and interconnection to customers.
